findings.evidence: "This skill is a **Process** (a fixed Step 0→4 sequence: locate, detect, ask, write, report) executed with **Tool-level rigor**"
findings.fix: Delete the pattern self-label; the steps already carry the procedure.

findings.evidence: "python3 -c " with kept_clis and chosen left as angle-bracket comments inside the script
findings.fix: Give the agent a complete snippet that reads the kept names and chosen ids from a scratch JSON the previous ask wrote, instead of a template it must finish by hand.

findings.evidence: Process pattern is right, but the 476-line body plus a 344-line mandatory catalog procedure is far past the ~200-line process shape
findings.fix: Keep Steps 0-4 as the process and move the vendor, pair-storage and session-default detail behind the same conditional reads already used for the catalog.

findings.evidence: "Carry the answer into this entry's `purpose` field ... A candidate's `purpose` ... an absent `purpose` reads as matches both roles" in cli-model-selection.md line 303, while execute_selection.purpose_matches treats None as both but config_migrate.split_by_purpose sends a missing purpose to review only
findings.fix: State the two consumers separately: resolution treats a missing purpose as both roles, and migration of an old roster places a missing purpose in review only.

findings.evidence: "MANDATORY — READ ENTIRE FILE" and "NEVER set any range limits when reading this file" for the 344-line references/cli-model-selection.md
findings.fix: Gate each of the eight numbered items with its own condition, and drop the instruction to load the whole file with no range.

findings.evidence: "When the runtime's profile ... has `read_only: unconfirmed`" — claude.md and grok.md are bare `read_only: unconfirmed`, while cursor.md and codex.md quote the word confirmed inside a longer string
findings.fix: Say the ask fires only when the profile's read_only value is exactly the bare token unconfirmed or the profile file is absent; a quoted confirmed value skips it.

findings.evidence: "Always ask this via AskUserQuestion with multiSelect: true, consistently across every multi-provider CLI — never single-select here"
findings.fix: Keep multiSelect as the default and allow single-select only when the user already said they want exactly one family.

findings.evidence: 18 queries: 9 should-trigger and 9 should-not-trigger, short of about 20 with 8-10 on each side, and the negatives are unrelated tasks rather than near-misses
findings.fix: Add two near-miss negatives, such as running a review with the existing lanes and editing a non-lane table in config.toml, so the set reaches about 20.

findings.evidence: "Set up my cross-AI reviewers for this project." has only two assertions, both about detection and check-providers, with no check that a roster was written
findings.fix: Add one assertion per setup case that the announced path received a [lanes] table only after the replacement answer, and that a declined test is reported untested.

findings.evidence: "the consumer side reads an absent `purpose` as matches both review and execute" contradicts split_by_purpose, which puts anything other than execute or both into the review list
findings.fix: Name resolve_reviewers and purpose_matches as the both-roles readers, and name split_by_purpose as review-only for a missing purpose, so the agent does not describe a migrated roster as serving both lanes.

findings.evidence: "CONFIRMED_KEY=$(python3 -c " ... sys.path.insert(0, '$(dirname "$TOOLS_PY")')" after Step 0 says those names are literal paths, not shell variables
findings.fix: Tell the agent to paste the captured directory of ai-kit-spec.py into sys.path.insert, and not to rely on $TOOLS_PY surviving into a new shell.
